items.title: Path of the chemical message carried by hormones (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Path of the chemical message carried by hormones: a main subheading of 16.1.1 Chemical Nature of Hormones, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 59-59.

blocks.text: Endocrine glands koi khaas stimulus (uksane wali cheez) milne par apne hormones chhorte hain. Woh hormones khoon mein chhorte hain, aur khoon hormone ko tamam cells tak le jata hai. Har hormone sirf apne target cells par asar karta hai. Target cells mein receptors hote hain, aur har receptor ek khaas hormone se jurta hai. Jab hormone receptor se jurta hai to yeh jor aise waqiat shuru karta hai jin se cell ke andar tabdeeliyan aati hain. Receptors cell membrane par, cytoplasm mein ya cell ke nucleus mein ho sakte hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit: hormones aur neurotransmitters
blocks.text: Hormones aur neurotransmitters dono chemical messengers hain. Farq yeh hai ke hormones endocrine system ka hissa hain aur neurotransmitters nervous system ka. Hormones aam taur par der se asar karte hain aur un ka asar zyada der tak rehta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka asaan tareeqa: jo hormone pani mein hal hai (peptide, protein, glycoprotein, epinephrine) woh membrane paar nahin kar sakta, is liye us ke receptors cell ki sateh par hote hain. Jo charbi mein hal hai (steroids, aur thyroxine/T₃) woh membrane paar kar ke cell ke andar (cytoplasm ya nucleus) receptors se jurta hai.

blocks.prompt: Insulin aur testosterone ke receptors kahan hote hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Insulin peptide hormone hai, pani mein hal hota hai aur cell membrane paar nahin kar sakta, is liye us ke receptors cell ki sateh par hote hain. Testosterone steroid hai, charbi mein hal hota hai aur membrane paar kar leta hai, is liye us ke receptors cell ke andar (cytoplasm ya nucleus mein) hote hain.

items: Hormones ke chaar kimiyai groups: peptide/protein (insulin, glucagon, GH, oxytocin), glycoprotein (TSH, FSH, LH), amino acid derivatives (epinephrine, norepinephrine, T₄, T₃) aur steroids (cortisol, aldosterone, testosterone, estrogen, progesterone).
Peptide aur glycoprotein hormones membrane paar nahin karte: receptors sateh par. Steroids cholesterol se bante hain aur membrane paar kar ke nucleus tak hidayat dete hain.
Har hormone sirf us target cell par asar karta hai jis mein us ka receptor ho; receptors membrane, cytoplasm ya nucleus mein hote hain.
